verdict.rationale: Workable documents a first-party MCP server covering the full hiring lifecycle, so users can drive the product through natural language from an AI client. It also offers a Workable Agent that runs sourcing and screening, and AI-assisted candidate search. However, no in-product natural-language command interface is documented, and natural-language operation depends on an external MCP client. missing for 10: native in-app natural-language command/chat interface, documentation of natural-language prompts or examples for operating jobs and candidates, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: The Workable MCP server provides full programmatic access to the Workable recruiting and HR platform. It covers the entire hiring lifecycle — from job management and candidate sourcing through offer approvals
The Workable Agent runs the top of the funnel - sourcing, screening and qualifying every candidate against the spec - and hands your team an interview-ready shortlist.
Search yourself or use AI to find qualified candidates that match your specific requirements.
